top_signals.title: The 72-hour crisis that could upend Meta’s business in India as firm risks losing legal protection
top_signals.summary: U.S. social media giant Meta is facing increasing pressure from Indian regulators, including demands to revoke the firm's safe harbor immunity in the country.
